errors.says: Method: 'run the first b+1<=K rounds on prefix slots bit by bit, run the remaining qK rounds with the fast simultaneous layer'.
errors.paper: The prefix-slot rounds are not all first. The round at h=l-1 on the long axes comes first, then the qK layer rounds h=l-2..b, and finally the bottom prefix positions h=b-1..0.

errors.says: 'At a node with e=m^k chunks, the s children plus binary basis changes, scalar gates, endpoint corrections and reassembly cost O(V((eK)^tau+1)) at that node.'
errors.paper: The node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)) covers the basis changes, scalar gates, endpoint corrections and reassembly only. The s recursive calls are charged separately, as s(V/W)F(e/m) in the recurrence.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}): the finite networks, frames, labels and rank saving (S4.1-S4.4), the two fast tape procedures and their recurrences (S4.5, S4.6), the ring convolution (S5), resampling with retained permutations (S6), chirp and permutation cancellation (S7), the assembled algorithm with exact recovery (S8), and the cost table (S9). Every link is derived with sub-steps that track the paper. The only thin spots are minor: a misordered description of the prefix rounds in S5.2, loose wording of the node overhead in S4.6.3.2, and the conjecture-negation logic, which is only alluded to in S1.

steps.note: It has h=100, N=v^3 with v=binom(100,3), m=h^3, banks indexed by a in T^3 (S4.1.2), and a fixed linear network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire.
A common invertible frame commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and each edge pays only D_vD_u^{-1}. The intermediate frames are then free to make edges cheap.
Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of F^{otimes3} of dimension m and every edge joins comparable labels. The only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges, each removing P(x)F(x)Q of dimension h.
For nested U in V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U. The N source edges are the exceptions, each with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one.
sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, by telescoping at the gates, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.

It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and says that the N extra source ranks still leave a strict saving (deficit 2N-2L_c>0 stated for the complex network, s_b<W_b m for the bit network).
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, checked as P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. Through the frame identity this gives the shear H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Each edge's interchanges are recursive calls, so a node makes exactly s calls.
Children have volume V/W, so F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). With eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P07 rebuilds the whole central chain with its defining quantities: the h=100 bank-exchange network, the common-frame identity, the nested labels with the only loss at the central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, rank-a shears as a recursive calls (s per node), and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps are reconstructed.
